stemMd: A laboratory attributes declining contamination to a newly introduced one-way movement rule for samples. Which finding most strengthens this attribution?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Comparable rooms retaining the old movement pattern showed no decline during the same period, while rooms adopting the rule did.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The laboratory processes different sample types.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The laboratory’s walls were painted several years earlier.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Contamination is measured as a percentage.

explanationMd: The contemporaneous comparison makes a common time-related cause less plausible and associates the change specifically with adopting the movement rule.

distractorRationale.c: The timing is unrelated to the current change.
distractorRationale.e: Attitude does not identify the cause of the decline.
distractorRationale.b: Variety alone does not isolate the movement rule.
distractorRationale.d: The choice of unit does not establish causation.
